rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for temporarily looking after someone else’s child, including babysitting for pay.

example.english: I’m going to babysit for someone tonight and won’t get home until eleven.
example.traditional: 我今晚幫人湊仔，十一點先返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 bong1 jan4 cau3 zai2 sap6 jat1 dim2 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the context already makes clear that you mean looking after children rather than raising or caring for your own child.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 maan5 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 cau3 zai2
